flows.name: Discover the studio on the landing page
flows.goal: Understand what the studio sells and how to order, and start shopping.

steps.userAction: The shopper arrives on the public landing page.
steps.websiteResponse: The website explains what Mitti Studio sells in small batches, guest ordering without messaging, free Jaipur studio pickup versus Rs.99 courier with free courier over Rs.1,500, pay-later-by-UPI, and shows a start-shopping entry.

steps.userAction: The shopper chooses to start shopping.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the live catalog with current pieces and stock states.

flows.outcome: Nothing is stored; the shopper knows pickup, shipping and pay-later terms and the catalog is one action away after a refresh.

flows.name: Browse catalog with live stock
flows.goal: Browse live pieces and find what is still available.

steps.userAction: The shopper opens the public catalog.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows products with photos, piece type, description, glaze and size options, price and live stock with Almost Gone flags and disabled Sold Out variants.

steps.userAction: The shopper narrows the list by piece type and by in-stock versus sold-out.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows only the products matching the chosen piece type and availability.

alternatives.condition: No products are published yet.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says no pieces are listed right now and invites the shopper to check back or contact the studio.

alternatives.condition: No products match the chosen piece type or availability.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says no pieces match and offers to clear the filters.

flows.outcome: No data is changed; the shopper has seen current products and stock states that persist after a refresh.

flows.name: Place a guest pickup or courier order
flows.goal: Order chosen pieces as a guest without messaging.
preconditions: At least one variant in stock.

steps.userAction: The shopper opens a product from the catalog.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the product name, piece type, description, photos, glaze and size variants with price and live stock, Almost Gone flags, and disabled Sold Out variants.

steps.userAction: The shopper chooses an in-stock glaze and size variant and quantity and adds it to the order, repeating for more variants as needed.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the order items with quantities and running items total and blocks zero-stock variants.

steps.userAction: The shopper chooses studio pickup or courier and optionally types one weekend discount code.
steps.websiteResponse: The website validates the code against its start and end dates, shows the discount, and shows totals with Rs.99 courier or free courier when the total after discount reaches Rs.1,500 and always-free pickup, plus the studio pickup address.

steps.userAction: The shopper enters name, phone, and courier address when fulfillment is courier.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the order summary with items, fulfillment, discount, shipping and total plus pay-by-UPI-later instructions.

steps.userAction: The shopper places the order.
steps.websiteResponse: The website stores the order as New and Unpaid, reduces variant stock, and shows a confirmation with order details, totals, fulfillment instructions and pay-by-UPI-later text.

alternatives.condition: The product was archived in the meantime.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says the piece is no longer available and shows the catalog.

alternatives.condition: The quantity is empty, zero, or more than the live stock.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website marks the quantity and keeps what was typed.

alternatives.condition: Adding the items fails.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website keeps the chosen variant and quantity and offers to retry.

alternatives.condition: The chosen variant just sold out.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says the variant just sold out, marks it Sold Out, and shows the product with remaining options.

alternatives.condition: No fulfillment choice is selected.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website marks the fulfillment choice and keeps the typed code.

alternatives.condition: The code is unknown, expired, or outside its start and end dates.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website rejects the code with a message, keeps the order items, and allows ordering without a code or with a different code.

alternatives.condition: Applying fulfillment and discount fails.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website keeps the chosen fulfillment and typed code and offers to retry.

alternatives.condition: Name or phone is missing or phone is not valid, or courier address is missing for courier.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website marks what is wrong and keeps all typed values.

alternatives.condition: Saving the contact details fails.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website keeps all typed values and offers to retry.

alternatives.condition: Placing the order fails.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website keeps the order details and offers to retry placing the order.

alternatives.condition: Stock changed and a chosen variant has no stock left at ordering time.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says which variant is now Sold Out, removes it from the order, and shows updated totals.

flows.outcome: An Order is stored as New and Unpaid with items, fulfillment, discount and totals and variant stock is reduced; confirmation and order details remain after a refresh.

flows.name: Studio owner sign up

steps.userAction: The owner chooses to create the studio account.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows an empty owner auth form.

steps.userAction: The owner fills in email and password and submits.
steps.websiteResponse: The website creates the single shop account, signs her in, and shows her shop workspace.

alternatives.condition: Email or password is missing or not valid.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website marks what is wrong and keeps what was typed.

alternatives.condition: Creating the account fails.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website keeps the typed values and offers to retry.

alternatives.condition: An owner account already exists for the email.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says the account exists and offers to sign in instead.

alternatives.condition: The owner cancels signing up.
alternatives.websiteResponse: Nothing is created; the website shows public pages.

flows.outcome: The owner account exists and the owner is signed in; refresh keeps her signed in.

flows.name: Studio owner sign in
flows.goal: Sign in to manage the shop.

steps.userAction: The owner chooses to sign in.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the owner auth form.

steps.userAction: The owner fills in email and password and submits.
steps.websiteResponse: The website signs her in and shows her own products, orders and codes.

alternatives.condition: Email or password is missing or not valid.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website marks what is wrong and keeps what was typed.

alternatives.condition: Signing in fails.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website keeps the typed values and offers to retry.

alternatives.condition: No account exists for the email or the password is wrong.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says the sign-in details are not recognized and allows another try.

flows.outcome: The owner is signed in and sees her shop workspace; refresh keeps her signed in.

flows.name: Studio owner sign out

steps.userAction: The owner chooses to sign out.
steps.websiteResponse: The website ends the session and shows public pages; owner pages require sign-in again.

flows.outcome: The session is ended; refresh shows public pages and owner pages require sign-in again.

flows.name: View and fulfill orders
flows.goal: See new orders and move them through packing, dispatch and payment.

steps.userAction: The owner opens the order list.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows orders newest first with items, fulfillment type, totals, discount used, order status and Unpaid or Paid state plus order counts.

steps.userAction: The owner finds orders by status.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows only orders with the chosen status.

steps.userAction: The owner opens an order.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the order items, fulfillment choice and address, discount used, totals with shipping, order status and payment state.

steps.userAction: The owner marks the order Packed, then Shipped for courier or Picked Up for pickup, and marks UPI Paid after collecting.
steps.websiteResponse: The website stores the new status and payment state and shows the updated order.

steps.userAction: The owner chooses to cancel the order.
steps.websiteResponse: The website asks to confirm cancellation and says the Order will be marked Cancelled, Variant stock will be restored, and nothing will be deleted.

alternatives.condition: No orders exist yet.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says no orders have come in yet and shows how new guest orders will appear.

alternatives.condition: No orders match the chosen status.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says no orders have that status and offers to clear the filter.

alternatives.condition: The order was removed or cannot be found.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says the order is gone and shows the newest-first order list.

alternatives.condition: Updating status or payment fails.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website keeps the order as it was and offers to retry.

alternatives.condition: The status change is not allowed, such as shipping before packing or picking up a courier order.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website explains the allowed order flow New to Packed to Shipped or Picked Up and keeps the order unchanged.

alternatives.condition: The owner confirms cancellation.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website marks the Order Cancelled, restores Variant stock, deletes nothing, and shows the updated newest-first list.

alternatives.condition: The owner cancels the cancellation.
alternatives.websiteResponse: Nothing is changed; the website shows the order again unchanged.

flows.outcome: Order status and payment state changes are stored and stock is restored on cancel; the updated newest-first list remains after a refresh.

flows.name: Create a product with variants
flows.goal: Add a new piece with its glaze and size options.

steps.userAction: The owner chooses to add a product.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows an empty product form with space for glaze and size variants.

steps.userAction: The owner fills in name, piece type, description and photos.
steps.websiteResponse: The website validates each photo as an image, shows a preview kept for the session, and keeps all typed values.

steps.userAction: The owner fills in one or more glaze and size variants with price and stock and publishes the listing.
steps.websiteResponse: The website stores the product with its variants and shows it in the owner catalog and in the shopper catalog with live stock.

alternatives.condition: Product name, piece type, photo, or variant glaze, size, price or stock is missing or not valid.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website marks what is wrong and keeps all typed values and photo previews.

alternatives.condition: Saving the product details or photo preview fails.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website keeps all typed values and previews and offers to retry.

alternatives.condition: The photo is not a valid image.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website rejects the photo with a message, keeps the other values, and allows choosing another photo.

alternatives.condition: Variant glaze, size, price or stock is missing or not valid.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website marks what is wrong and keeps all typed variant values.

alternatives.condition: Publishing the product fails.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website keeps all product and variant values and offers to retry.

alternatives.condition: The owner cancels creating the product.
alternatives.websiteResponse: Nothing is saved; the website shows the owner catalog as it was.

flows.outcome: A Product with its Variants is stored and appears in the shopper catalog; it is still there after a refresh.

flows.name: Edit a product and its variants
flows.goal: Keep listings, prices and stock counts correct.

steps.userAction: The owner opens the product list.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows her products with name, piece type, photo, variant prices and live stock states including Almost Gone and Sold Out.

steps.userAction: The owner opens a product from the list.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the product name, piece type, description, photos and its glaze and size variants with price and stock count.

steps.userAction: The owner edits the product details and saves them.
steps.websiteResponse: The website validates the photo, shows a preview, saves the changes and shows the updated listing.

steps.userAction: The owner edits a variant glaze, size, price and stock count and saves it.
steps.websiteResponse: The website saves the variant and refreshes its Almost Gone and Sold Out flags in the listing and shopper catalog.

alternatives.condition: There are no products.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says there are no products yet and offers to create one.

alternatives.condition: The product was archived in the meantime.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says the product is gone and shows the product list.

alternatives.condition: A required product field is empty or the photo is not an image.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website marks what is wrong and keeps what was typed.

alternatives.condition: Saving the product fails.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website keeps the values and offers to retry.

alternatives.condition: Glaze or size is empty, price is missing, or stock count is negative.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website marks what is wrong and keeps what was typed.

alternatives.condition: Saving the variant fails.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website keeps the values and offers to retry.

alternatives.condition: The product has no variants yet.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website shows the product details with no variants and offers to edit the product details.

flows.outcome: Product and Variant changes are stored and the updated listing and stock states remain after a refresh.

flows.name: Archive a product
flows.goal: Remove a piece from sale without losing order history.

steps.userAction: The owner opens the product list.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows her products with name, piece type, photos and variant stock states.

steps.userAction: The owner opens a product from the list.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the product name, piece type, description, photos and its variants with price and stock count and an archive option.

steps.userAction: The owner chooses to archive the product.

alternatives.condition: There are no products.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says there are no products and offers to create one.

alternatives.condition: The product was already archived.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says the product is gone and shows the product list.

alternatives.condition: The owner confirmed archiving.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website hides the product from the public catalog, leaves past orders unchanged, and shows the product list without it.

alternatives.condition: The owner cancelled.
alternatives.websiteResponse: Nothing is archived; the website shows the product again, unchanged.

alternatives.condition: The product has no variants.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website shows the product details with no variants and still offers to archive it.

flows.outcome: The product is archived and absent from the public catalog but past orders are unchanged; the state persists after a refresh.

flows.name: Manage discount codes

steps.userAction: The owner opens the discount-code list.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows her codes with code value, percent off, start and end dates and whether each code is currently valid.

steps.userAction: The owner fills in a new weekend code, percent off and start and end dates and saves it.
steps.websiteResponse: The website saves the code and shows it in the list with its validity.

steps.userAction: The owner opens a code from the list.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the code value, percent off and start and end dates.

steps.userAction: The owner edits the code value, percent off or dates and saves the changes.
steps.websiteResponse: The website saves the changes and shows the updated code with its validity.

steps.userAction: The owner chooses to delete the code.

alternatives.condition: There are no discount codes yet.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says there are no codes yet and offers to create one.

alternatives.condition: The code is empty, the percent is outside 1 to 90, a date is missing, or the end date is before the start date.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website marks what is wrong and keeps what was typed.

alternatives.condition: Saving the new code fails.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website keeps the values and offers to retry.

alternatives.condition: The code was deleted in the meantime.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says the code is gone and shows the code list.

alternatives.condition: The code is empty, the percent is outside 1 to 90, a date is missing, or the end date is before the start date.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website marks what is wrong and keeps what was typed.

alternatives.condition: Saving the changes fails.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website keeps the values and offers to retry.

alternatives.condition: The owner confirmed the deletion.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website deletes the code and shows the code list without it.

alternatives.condition: The owner cancelled.
alternatives.websiteResponse: Nothing is deleted; the website shows the code again, unchanged.

flows.outcome: DiscountCode records are created, updated or deleted; the current list and their validity remain after a refresh.

flows.name: View low-glaze warnings
flows.goal: Know which glazes are nearly gone.

steps.userAction: The owner opens the low-stock view.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows variants with 3 or fewer units left with product name, glaze, size and remaining count for planning the next batch.

alternatives.condition: No variant has 3 or fewer units left.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says all glazes are sufficiently stocked and offers to return to the product list.

flows.outcome: Nothing is changed; the low-stock list with current counts is still shown after a refresh until stock changes.

fields.label: Product name
fields.meaning: How the studio and shoppers refer to the piece listing

fields.label: Piece type
fields.meaning: Grouping of the piece as Mug, Bowl, Planter or Vase

fields.label: Product description
fields.meaning: What the piece is, how it is made and how it looks
fields.example: Hand-thrown stoneware mug with speckled glaze, 300 ml.

fields.label: Product photo
fields.meaning: Photo of the piece that shoppers see; validated and previewed before saving

fields.label: Glaze
fields.meaning: Colour/finish option of the variant

fields.label: Size
fields.meaning: Size or capacity option of the variant

fields.label: Variant price
fields.meaning: Price in rupees for one unit of this glaze-plus-size variant

fields.label: Variant stock count
fields.meaning: How many units of this variant are left and can be sold

fields.label: Quantity
fields.meaning: How many units of the chosen variant the shopper wants, limited by live stock

fields.label: Fulfillment choice
fields.meaning: Whether the shopper picks up free at the Jaipur studio or pays for courier

fields.label: Discount code entered
fields.meaning: Optional weekend code the shopper types at checkout for percent off

fields.label: Shopper name
fields.meaning: Who the guest order belongs to for packing and contact

fields.label: Shopper phone
fields.meaning: Phone number to contact the shopper about pickup or courier and UPI collection

fields.label: Courier address
fields.meaning: Delivery address, required only when fulfillment choice is Courier

fields.label: Code value
fields.meaning: Short code shared on Instagram that shoppers type at checkout

fields.label: Discount percent
fields.meaning: Percent off the items total when the code is valid

fields.label: Discount start date
fields.meaning: First day the code can be used

fields.label: Discount end date
fields.meaning: Last day the code can be used

fields.label: Owner email
fields.meaning: Email the studio owner uses to sign in

fields.label: Owner password
fields.meaning: Secret that protects the owner account

fields.label: Availability filter
fields.meaning: Shopper filter to show in-stock pieces versus sold-out pieces

fields.label: Order status filter
fields.meaning: Owner filter to find orders by New, Packed, Shipped, Picked Up or Cancelled

fields.label: Piece type filter
fields.meaning: Shopper filter to show pieces of one piece type or all piece types

steps.websiteResponse: The website asks to confirm the deletion and says what else will be removed with it.

alternatives.condition: The user confirms.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website deletes the record and what belongs to it.

alternatives.condition: The user cancels.
alternatives.websiteResponse: Nothing is deleted; the record stays as it was.

assumptions.text: Archived products are hidden from the shopper catalog but past orders keep their product, variant, price and quantity details unchanged.
Owner order list is newest first; order total is items total minus percent discount plus courier fee per the Rs.99 / free over Rs.1,500 rule.
Product photos are validated as images and previewed before saving and kept for the session per file-upload simulation; no external storage is implied.

questions.question: Can one guest order contain multiple different glaze/size variants?
questions.whyItMatters: Determines whether checkout supports a basket of items versus a single variant and how totals and stock checks work.
questions.defaultAnswer: Yes - one order can contain multiple variants and quantities; stock is checked per variant.
